title: Purple Ledger Nano X in a video shared by @kryptodegeny

components: Main board wrapped in yellow Kapton tape
Black board on the battery, with a fine wire loop and solder pad
Battery with a yellow flex tail
implant.notes: An 88-second video of a purple Nano X being taken apart on a workbench, posted by a Polish crypto account as commentary on the implant reports. The main board is wrapped in yellow Kapton tape, and a black board with a fine wire sits on the battery. Neither is normal for a Nano X. Mark Karpelès (@MagicalTux) confirmed it as an implant on 14 Oct 2026, though the individual parts can't be identified from the footage. The device still boots to Ledger's onboarding screen. The post doesn't say who filmed the video, or where the device was bought.

sources.author: Krypto Degeneraci.
sources.text:
KUPUJESZ LEDGERA, A W ŚRODKU MASZ PODSŁUCH, KTÓRY KRADNIE TWOJE BITCOINY

Badacze rozebrali zmodyfikowane Ledger Nano X i znaleźli w środku dodatkową elektronikę z modemem LTE i kartą SIM.

I teraz najlepsze. Ten mały skurczybyk potrafi przechwycić 24 słowa seeda wyświetlane…

(Polish: "You buy a Ledger, and inside there's a bug that steals your bitcoins. Researchers took apart modified Ledger Nano X units and found extra electronics inside, with an LTE modem and a SIM card. And now the best part: this little rascal can intercept the 24 seed words displayed…")
